d: Lodoiska apartments in Boleslao's palace. Polish choir that have flower branches in hand to celebrate the hymeneus. Lodoiska, Resiska and Chorus.
Boleslaus, and sayings, then Radoski.
Radoski hasty, and sayings.
Lodoiska, Resiska, and Radoski.
Radoski alone.

Wide, and irregular forest at the foot of a mountain on which you can see from the long curtains of the Tartars. At the opposite side, view, and entrance of the castle of Boleslaus with drawbridge. Giskano with Tartar soldiers, who descend to the sound of military march from the mountain singing the following choir.
Lovinski from the forest on a path different from the one for which the Tartars left.
Lovinski, Narseno, choir of Poles, choir of Tartari. The voice of the following Choir is heard far away.
Lovinski alone.
Narseno with bare sword, with the Polish Prisoners liberated and said.
Boleslaus, Radoski, Polish soldiers with some Prisoners and sayings.
Boleslaus, Radoski, and guards.
Radoski alone.
Handsome grove, lonely resiska.
Large dark underground with two intricate paths; opposite, on the right side of the theater, steep and secret exit from the apartments of Lodoiska. Dark night. Lodoiska, then Lovinski, in Boleslaus.

Military fences in one of the squares of the castle, with weapons and warriors tools pompously arranged. Radoski, and Narseno enter the sound of military march on stage, with some Tartar Prisoners, and with the Polish winners, who hang on the fences the trophies, and the flags taken to the Tartars.
Boleslaus, and sayings.
Boleslaus, and Radoski.
Boleslaus, then Lovinski.
Resiska alone.
Lodoiska, and said.
Boleslaus with follow-up, and choir of Poles, sayings.
Boleslaus, Chorus, and Followers, in Narseno.
Boleslaus, follow, choir of Poles.
Magnificent place corresponding to the palace of Boleslaus. Lodoiska weeping to sit on a boulder, Resiska indi Boleslao with Seguaci.
Lovinski, Narseno, and sayings.
Boleslaus alone.
Radoski leading Sigeski by the hand.
Atrium of the Boleslao palace with circular colonnade square. On one side seat distinct as a throne. Boleslao. Choir of Poles, and Custodi. Then Radoski, Lodoiska and Resiska.
Lovinski, Narseno, and then Sigeski, and sayings.

Great gun room of the castle, as in the scene before the first act, but without any festive ornament. Lodoiska and Sigeski with Guards, some of which guard the entrances. Sigeski, is sitting thoughtfully.
Boleslaus, Radoski, then Lovinski chained between the soldiers, and sayings.
They remain a thoughtful moment in affliction, and then Lodoiska says resolute.

View of the castle of Boleslao in another more secret part of the forest, where you can see the last tents of the camp of the Tartars. Picciola door of secret exit of the castle. Radoski leaving hasty from the castle with Sigeski, and Narseno.
Giskano following Tartari from various parts, which surround them.

Horrid castle prison with three huge arches at the bottom locked by high wooden doors, which remain in its time overturned, and let see the great square of the castle. The prison receives no other light, than that of a ray of light from a high ironed window. On the left side of the theater, steep but not very high staircase for which you descend into the prison. Lovinski only sitting on a boulder, Boleslaus, and Lodoiska.
